title: Puzzle Solving using Reasoning of Large Language Models: A Survey
best_for_zh: 需要选择谜题推理评测、比较提示与神经符号方法的读者。
one_line: An EMNLP 2024 survey of language-model puzzle solving, organized around rule-based and rule-less puzzles.
以规则型与非规则型谜题为主线，梳理语言模型解题的方法、数据集、基准与困难。
why: It offers a concrete way to choose puzzle evaluations and distinguish a convincing-looking answer from constraint-respecting reasoning.
inclusion_reason: An EMNLP 2024 survey that connects puzzle families, methods, datasets, and evaluation limitations for language-model reasoning.

title: Problem
问题
html: Puzzles expose whether a model can respect constraints and draw non-obvious conclusions, rather than merely produce a fluent explanation. This EMNLP 2024 survey studies language-model puzzle solving through rule-based and rule-less puzzle categories, the methods used on them, and the datasets and benchmarks that measure them. It summarizes existing work and releases no new benchmark. The reader-facing question is not simply whether a model returns an appealing answer. It is whether the answer satisfies the puzzle's stated conditions, and whether the evaluation can distinguish genuine constraint handling from a familiar pattern. That distinction makes puzzles a useful but demanding surface for studying reasoning.
谜题能检验模型是否真正遵守约束并推出不直观的结论，而不只是写出流畅解释。这篇 EMNLP 2024 综述把语言模型解谜分为规则型与非规则型两类，整理相应方法、数据集和基准；它汇总已有研究，并不发布新的基准。读者需要问的不只是模型是否给出一个好听的答案，而是答案是否满足题目写明的条件，以及评测能否区分真正处理约束和套用了熟悉模式。这一区别使谜题成为研究推理的有用但要求很高的检验表面。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper's organizing idea is that puzzle structure matters. Rule-based puzzles provide explicit constraints; rule-less puzzles require more interpretation or creative inference. It compares prompting, neuro-symbolic approaches, and fine-tuning against that taxonomy, so a reader can ask whether a method is solving the right kind of difficulty rather than treating all puzzles alike. The split is useful because an explicit constraint checker and an ambiguous clue pose different demands. Before reading a score, identify what information is given, which conclusions must be derived, and how correctness is decided. A method that works with clear formal rules should not automatically be expected to resolve an underspecified or creative puzzle.

论文的主线是：谜题结构决定了难点。规则型谜题给出明确约束；非规则型谜题需要更多解释或创造性推断。论文在这一分类下比较提示、神经符号方法和微调，使读者能判断一种方法在解决哪种困难，而不是把所有谜题当成同类任务。这一区分很实用，因为显式约束检查器与含糊线索带来的要求并不相同。读分数前，应辨认题目给出了哪些信息、必须推出哪些结论、以及正确性如何判定。一个适合清晰形式规则的方法，不应自动被期待解决定义不足或更具创造性的谜题。

title: Method
方法
html: This is a literature synthesis. It maps puzzle families to methods, then reviews relevant datasets and benchmarks. A typical primary task presents a puzzle statement and clues or constraints, asks for a solution, and checks whether that solution satisfies the task conditions. The surveyed approaches include prompting, neuro-symbolic systems, and fine-tuning. Use this recurring task schema when consulting the cited studies: record the input puzzle, the permitted answer form, the constraints that must hold, and the scoring rule. The survey does not prescribe one solver. Its method is to relate solver choices to puzzle structure and to show where a dataset or benchmark supplies enough information for a meaningful comparison.

这是一篇文献综述。论文先把谜题类型与方法对应起来，再回顾相关数据集和基准。典型任务会给出谜题陈述及线索或约束，要求给出解答，并检查解答是否满足题目条件。被整理的方法包括提示、神经符号系统和微调。查阅被引研究时，可使用同一任务结构：记录输入谜题、允许的答案形式、必须成立的约束以及计分规则。本文并不规定唯一的求解器；它的做法是把求解选择与谜题结构联系起来，并说明数据集或基准何时提供了足以进行有意义比较的信息。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The survey critically reviews datasets and benchmarks and reports that complex puzzle settings remain challenging, especially when advanced logical inference is required. This is not a single head-to-head experiment, so it should not be read as a universal ranking of methods. The relevant evidence in each cited study depends on its puzzle family, scoring rule, and model setup. A high aggregate score is weak evidence if the benchmark permits shortcuts or accepts answers without checking every constraint. Conversely, an error can reveal a useful limit only when the required inference is clear. Readers should preserve the link between result, puzzle definition, and correctness test instead of carrying a performance claim into another puzzle family.

论文批判性回顾数据集和基准，并指出复杂谜题仍然困难，尤其是需要较强逻辑推断的情形。这不是一次统一的对照实验，不能把它理解为方法的通用排名。每项被引用研究的证据都依赖其谜题类型、计分规则和模型设置。如果基准允许捷径，或接受没有逐项检查约束的答案，那么很高的总分仍是较弱证据。相反，只有所需推断足够清楚时，一次错误才真正揭示能力边界。读者应把结果、谜题定义和正确性检查保持关联，而不要把某个表现说法直接搬到另一个谜题家族。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Its distinctive contribution is a puzzle-specific taxonomy that separates rule-based from rule-less settings while connecting that split to methods and evaluation resources. The paper treats puzzle solving as a way to inspect the gap between a plausible answer and constraint-respecting reasoning, not simply as another general question-answering score. The novelty is organizational rather than a new solver or benchmark. It gives readers a way to state what is being tested: following explicit rules, combining clues, handling ambiguity, or producing a solution that can be checked. This prevents the word “reasoning” from becoming a catch-all label and makes it easier to see why two puzzle results may not be directly comparable.

它的特点是给出面向谜题的分类：区分规则型和非规则型，并把这一差别与方法、评测资源连起来。论文把解谜视为检查“看似合理的答案”和“满足全部约束的推理”之间差距的工具，而不是又一个泛泛的问答分数。新意在于组织视角，而不是提出新求解器或新基准。它让读者能明确说出自己在测什么：遵守显式规则、组合线索、处理歧义，还是产生可检查的解答。这样“推理”不会变成包罗万象的标签，也更容易看出两项解谜结果为何未必能直接比较。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Puzzle benchmarks can be narrow and may reward patterns specific to a family of tasks. Rule-less puzzles can introduce ambiguity in both the intended answer and scoring, while rule-based puzzles can still be solved by shortcuts if instances are poorly designed. Results therefore need to be tied to the exact puzzle definition and check used. The survey also does not turn heterogeneous primary studies into a single controlled comparison. Differences in model, prompt, access to tools, training data, and answer format can matter as much as the named method. Do not treat a fluent explanation as proof that constraints were respected, and do not infer broad reasoning ability from success on one puzzle format.
谜题基准可能较窄，并奖励某一类题目特有的模式。非规则型谜题可能让标准答案和计分都带有歧义；规则型谜题如果设计不佳，也可能被捷径解出。因此结果必须和具体谜题定义及检查方式一起阅读。本文也没有把异质的原始研究变成一次统一的受控比较。模型、提示、工具可用性、训练数据和答案形式的差异，可能与方法名称一样重要。不要把流畅解释当作遵守约束的证明，也不要依据某一种谜题形式上的成功推断广泛的推理能力。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this survey to choose a puzzle evaluation that matches the capability you want to inspect. It is useful for deciding whether explicit constraints, symbolic components, richer training data, or a different benchmark are needed. It also helps turn a vague claim of “good reasoning” into a checkable question about which constraints a solution must obey. Start by selecting the puzzle family, then write down the expected output and the validity test. Compare prompting, neuro-symbolic systems, and fine-tuning only after that specification is fixed. For a new evaluation, use the survey to ask whether wrong answers can be diagnosed, whether all necessary clues are available, and whether the scoring rule rewards a correct solution rather than a persuasive narrative.

需要选择与目标能力相匹配的谜题评测时，可以使用这篇综述。它能帮助判断是否需要显式约束、符号组件、更丰富的训练数据或不同的基准，也能把“推理很好”这样的笼统说法变成可检验的问题：答案究竟要遵守哪些条件。先选择谜题家族，再写下预期输出和有效性测试；只有在这些规格固定后，才比较提示、神经符号系统和微调。设计新评测时，可借此追问错误答案能否被诊断、所有必要线索是否可得，以及计分规则奖励的是正确解答还是有说服力的叙述。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Begin with the rule-based versus rule-less distinction. For a cited benchmark, write down the puzzle input, the permitted outputs, and the correctness criterion before comparing model scores. Then compare prompting, neuro-symbolic, and fine-tuned approaches only within puzzle families where the evaluation conditions are comparable. When a paper reports a solution trace, check whether the trace establishes each required constraint or merely narrates a plausible path. Note whether the benchmark checks exact answers, satisfaction of conditions, or another measure. The survey is most useful when it turns a broad puzzle label into a precise description of the inference and verification burden faced by the system.
先理解规则型与非规则型的差别。阅读一个被引用基准时，先写下谜题输入、允许的输出和正确性标准，再比较模型分数。之后只在评测条件可比的谜题类型内比较提示、神经符号和微调方法。当论文给出求解轨迹时，检查轨迹是否确立了每项必需约束，还是仅叙述一条看似合理的路径。还要记录基准检查的是精确答案、条件满足，还是其他指标。本文最有价值之处，是把宽泛的“谜题”标签变成系统所面对的具体推断和验证负担。
